text:
Samir: Hey folks — planning a permanent move to Jersey (Channel Islands) end of May. Does that trigger payroll/tax nexus? Also curious about WFH stipend and equipment shipping. cc @Eva :wave:
Eva (People Ops): Congrats! Quick Qs first — will you remain a direct Redwood employee (yes/no)? Is this permanent or a 3-6 month stint? Those answers change payroll/benefits flow. I'll loop in payroll + tax. :mag:
Leah - Payroll: If homebase changes to Jersey we need the homebase-change form filled out: https://intra.redwood/hr/homebase-change. Attach proof of address and ID. Jersey can require employer filings depending on residency status. FYI we pro-rate the monthly WFH allowance from the effective date.
Ben - Tax: Jersey is not identical to UK tax rules — it’s a separate jurisdiction. For short-term visits (<90 days) usually no new payroll required, but a permanent move typically does. We need dates and prior 3 years travel history to assess residency. Send me `YYYY-MM-DD: country` lines.
Samir: I will be a direct employee and this is permanent — family moving. I'll compile travel history tonight. Any immediate red flags for benefits or pension?
Eva (People Ops): For benefits: health insurance continues but provider networks differ — some claims may need local providers. Dental and local GP access varies. Pensions depend on the scheme and local rules; we sometimes pause contributions if you become non-UK tax resident until we have legal clearance. We'll confirm with Legal.
Leah - Payroll: Practical notes: changing payroll jurisdiction can take 4–6 weeks for vendor updates (tax tables, pay codes, reporting). Payroll needs the effective date at least 30 days before the change to avoid a split-month payroll. If Redwood agrees to cover relocation costs, please submit relocation request form too.
Ben - Tax: Also watch social/employee charges — Jersey can have employer obligations that differ from UK NICs. If you remain on UK payroll but work from Jersey long-term, that creates risk for the company. Best is to complete the residency questionnaire ASAP.
Samir: One more — will standard relocation cover shipping of monitors/desk/laptop? Or do I need separate quotes?
Eva (People Ops): Approved relocations typically cover shipment of household goods and company equipment. If this is treated as a homebase change without a relocation package, equipment shipping is limited. Add shipping quotes to the homebase-change form and mark as "relocation" if you want company-covered moves.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: submit the homebase-change form within 30 days of planned move to avoid payroll lag. See policy: https://intra.redwood/policies/remote-work-homebase
Ben - Tax: Please also confirm whether you'll have any client-facing contracts in local jurisdiction — that can affect permanent establishment risk.
Samir: OK will do. Filling out the form tonight and attaching travel history + shipping quotes. Thanks for the fast replies. :thumbsup:
Eva (People Ops): Great — once we have the form and docs we'll aim for a 2-week turnaround on the initial payroll/tax readout. If anything looks complex we'll loop in Legal. Adding @Legal here so they can track.
Legal: Noted — we'll review pension/benefit continuity and any employment contract amendments if needed.
Leah - Payroll: Follow-up: contacted our payroll vendor — they can support Jersey but need official effective date + local tax IDs if applicable. Estimated vendor lead time ~6 weeks from submission.
Samir: Thanks everyone, will submit tonight and loop back here when done.
